title: After a historic 101-game losing streak, the Columbia Eagles finally got their win with support from Gatorade
summary: Gatorade helped support the Columbia Eagles with sports science insights and hydration education during the team's pursuit of success on and off the field.
body_markdown:
While Columbia didn't secure a win during the 2025 season, the team showed signs of progress, with increasingly competitive performances and growing momentum - including a game against East Lawrence, where they lost by just four points and had their highest offensive output of the year.


As the team prepared for the 2026 season, Gatorade’s support didn’t waver. For Head Coach Sammie Coates, that continued commitment left a lasting impression.


"Gatorade's investment in our team, from the science and education to the belief they showed in these young men, made a genuine difference, not only on the field, but in the locker room and in the classroom," said Coates. "These kids earned this victory through sweat and sacrifice, and having a brand like Gatorade support them in this way, it means everything."
